text:
Maya (CSM): Heads up — Ridgepoint renewal in ~7 weeks. Noticed a sharp drop in embeddings calls and a seat freeze. Procurement reached out asking for a comparison vs Embeddia. Putting triage thread here.
Leo (AM): can you drop the usage snippet + any error/latency trends?
Maya (CSM): quick telemetry slice: 
```
30d avg tokens/day: 42k -> 18k -> 4.5k (last 7d)
Active seats: 42 -> 26
Top routes: /embeddings (72%), /vector-search (18%), /chat (10%)
Errors: 502 spikes on 2024-10-03 (6m window) — recovered
Latency: p95 embeddings 85ms -> 90ms (steady)
```
Nina (Sales): Embeddia is pitching lower per-embedding price but their latency numbers are unverified. Do we know if Ridgepoint cares about on-prem or just cost?
Deepa (Ridgepoint): FYI, procurement looped me in. Main asks: 1) cost per 1M embeddings with and without caching 2) on-prem/VPC feasibility 3) security: does Redwood support bring-your-own-key (BYOK)?
Maya (CSM): noted. Finance also put a temporary hold on new annual commitments (internal note from CFO).
Dev (Eng): BYOK is supported for Private deployments; for a short pilot we can use a test KMS but full HSM/BYOK might add 2wk to setup. We can run a 10-day dedicated perf pilot on a 2xA10 pool to show throughput and caching gains.
Nina (Sales): propose: 10-day pilot + Optimize audit + a short cost-compare doc vs Embeddia. Offer pilot at 30% off list for pilot period. Legal, any restrictions? @legal-bot
legal-bot: automated note — standard trial NDA in place. Need SOC/PCI questions from Ridgepoint in writing to scope data classification.
Leo (AM): I'll draft the commercial term (pilot discount + rollback SLA). Maya, can you confirm exec sponsor and whether Ridgepoint wants a formal PoC SOW?
Maya (CSM): Exec sponsor is CTO (Aparna). She wants a 30-min perf readout and an engineer-to-engineer session. Deepa, can Aparna join?
Deepa (Ridgepoint): Aparna prefers a 30-min sync with engineering. Also clarified Embeddia promised a 2x cheaper rate but didn't show cache/kv behavior. If you can show a replicable 3x unit-cost improvement with caching + 8-bit quantization, we can escalate internally.
Dev (Eng): We'll prepare a short reproducible script and expected numbers. Example curl for embedding bulk run we'll provide: 
```
# run 100k embeddings (example)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model": "redwood/embed-v1", "input": ["...repeated payload..."]}'
```
Maya (CSM): I'll schedule the readout for tomorrow 10am PT and send the perf question checklist to Deepa now. Also preparing a one-pager aimed at Finance showing expected cost delta with caching and quantization toggles.
Nina (Sales): pinging product for a short comparative blurb vs Embeddia — @Dev can you note any architectural diffs (KV cache, batching, quantization support)?
Dev (Eng): short note: Redwood offers prefix/KV caching, dynamic batching with per-customer policies, and quantization-aware runtimes that keep latency stable. Embeddia appears to rely mainly on large-batch throughput without persistent KV cache.
Leo (AM): next steps I propose: 1) Send perf checklist to Ridgepoint 2) Lock 10-day pilot terms (discount + SLA) 3) Run pilot + Optimize audit 4) 72h follow-up for finance unblock.
Maya (CSM): accepted. Deepa — checklist posted, please fill perf targets (cost/latency) you'd expect.
Deepa (Ridgepoint): added targets: target p95 embeddings <120ms at 50k qps/day, cost target <$30 per 1M embeddings after caching. Will fill checklist by EOD.
legal-bot: request received — routing to Legal.
ops-bot: lifecycle note created: renewal_watch:ridgepoint:1715556666 assigned:@Maya; follow-up reminder 72h.
Nina (Sales): I'll prep a short commercial note for Aparna to expedite approval.
Maya (CSM): thanks team — I'll post meeting invite + checklist answers here once Deepa completes. :thumbsup:
